main_text.p: sciplinæ magister, ille quæ à Sancyrano hauserat, vulgata Theologorum Scholasticorum placita de attritione vix ferre poterat, & ob id inprimis apud Richelium male audiit; quia tunc temporis quidam Jesuita, qui erat à Confessione Regis Christianissimi, hanc doctrinam de necessitate contritionis contra vulgus Theologorum & communem societatis suæ sententiam Regi suggerebat, & quia Rex erat ingenio morofo ac difficili, rebus tractandis postea minus commodum illum expertus est Richelius. Itaqve Segvenoti de attritione sententia à Theologis Parisiensibus autore Cardinale Richelio damnata est, at in Jesuitæ illius rigidioris ac minus humani locum, alius Jesuita humanior ac mollior audiendæ Regis Confessioni succederet.

Interim Morinus Richelio atqve inprimis Celloto & Rabardeo Jesuitis, qui de Segvenoto palam in libris suis detraxerant, infensissimus nuncium sedis Apostolicæ una cum Bertado ejusdem Congregationis Oratorii Theologo invisit, & grega

page.notes: The first word is a fragment at the page start: the initial letter is cut off, so it is printed "sciplinæ", not "disciplinæ". "Itaqve" is partly uncertain in its last letters (printed with a curled q). The catchword "lera" at the lower right is only partly legible and may be a fragment of the next word. The word "grega" ends the page without a visible hyphen.
